about_the_game:
🧟‍♂️ About This Game

The world has fallen to a deadly zombie virus. Civilization has collapsed, cities are abandoned, and the streets are filled with death. You and a small group of survivors are struggling to build a new life.

But the zombies never stop… At night, they raid your home. During the day, you must venture into dangerous houses and forests in search of food, weapons, and resources.

To survive, you’ll need to find other survivors, recruit them into your colony, or leave them behind. Manage your resources wisely, craft weapons and tools, fortify your base, and withstand the ever-growing waves of attacks.

Expand your influence by capturing zones cleared of zombies, and encounter other survivor colonies to choose between 🤝 trading, 🕊️ alliances, or ⚔️ war.
You can also upgrade your gear and control the skill progression of both yourself and your recruited survivors.

🔑 Key Features

  • 🧟‍♂️ Zombie Apocalypse Setting – Explore abandoned houses and forests, scavenge supplies, and face deadly creatures.

  • 🔧 Resource Management & Crafting – Produce food, weapons, and defensive systems. Balance your resources or risk losing your colony.

  • 🏠 Colony Building & Defense – Recruit survivors, assign them tasks, and protect your base against nightly zombie raids.

  • ⚔️ Strategic Choices – Decide which houses to raid, which resources to gather, and who to recruit.

  • 🌲 Dynamic Loot & Threats – Each house hides different loot, each forest brings new dangers.

  • ⏳ Escalating Threat – Zombies grow stronger and more numerous every day.

  • 🌍 Colony Interaction – Trade, ally, or fight with other survivor colonies.

  • 🏴 Territory Control – Secure areas you clear of zombies and add them to your colony’s production.

  • ⚒️ Equipment Upgrades & Skills – Upgrade gear and manage the skills of yourself and your survivors.

⭐ Why Play?

This game blends survival + strategy + colony management + diplomacy into one experience.

  • ❌ A single wrong decision could starve your colony.

  • 🛡️ A successful defense could save your night.

  • 🤝 A smart trade or alliance could change your fate.

In a world overrun by zombies, your biggest threats aren’t just the undead… but scarcity, rival colonies, and your own choices.
How long can you last?

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes visuals of zombie creatures and survival scenarios.
